Logarithms with Base a
If a is any positive number other than 1, the function ax is one-to-one and has a nonzero derivative at every point. It therefore has a differentiable inverse.
DEFINITION For any positive number a ≠1, the logarithm of x with base a, denoted by log ax, is the inverse function of ax.
